title: Faster algorithm
summary: Fresh X0 executed 24 controls and eight actual hard children from four retained fixtures. Forced-cherry and endpoint-bonus rejections reproduced; all children tidy to TWO live components, so three-component bottleneck coverage is untested. Staging distinct macro and safe-cover routes. All three milestones remain open.

claims.label: Algorithm
claims.detail: All rules, terminal cases, fallbacks, applicability tests and reconstruction must be explicit.

claims.label: Correctness
claims.detail: Validity, optimum-preserving coverage and termination must hold for every input.

claims.label: Smaller base
claims.detail: Account for the full recursive search, local calls and generation cost in the original component parameter.

lemmas.label: Bottleneck cover
lemmas.detail: Replace the hard two-pendant child with explicit exhaustive branches whose charged mass improves the full recurrence.

lemmas.label: Safe decomposition
lemmas.detail: Generate a bounded optimum-preserving cover into exact terminal classes and pay for every local solver.
